text:
To see how this works, suppose we apply $ n{Mult}$ to Church numerals
  $
um{n}$ and $
um{m}$: $ n{Mult} \, 
um{n} \, 
um{m}$ reduces to
  $\lambd[fx][
um{n}(
um{m}\, f)x]$.  The term $
um{m} f$ defines a
  function which applies $f$ to its argument $m$ times. Consequently,
  $
um{n} (
um{m} f) x$ applies the function ``apply $f$ $m$ times''
  itself $n$ times to~$x$. In other words, we apply $f$ to $x$, $n\cdot
  m$ times. But the resulting normal term is just the Church numeral
  $
um{nm}$.
